name: Water Level Depth Sensor
fullName: Analog Submersible Liquid Depth & Water Level Detection Sensor Module
tagline: Measures water depth and liquid level through parallel trace resistance
description: The Water Level Sensor module consists of a series of exposed parallel conductive copper traces. When submerged, water conducts current between adjacent traces, varying the output analog voltage proportionally to water depth and immersion level.

pinout.name: Signal
pinout.desc: Analog output voltage proportional to water level

wiringNote: Only submerge the sensor up to the top mark of the parallel traces; never immerse the top connector pins or header.
commonMistakes: Submerging the entire module header in water
Continuous powering causing trace electrolysis corrosion (power via GPIO pin only when reading)
